label: Extended reviewable suite
summary: Ten distinct authored scenarios for each of nine Categories. Bias is excluded because it is governed by bias-v1.json and its nine subtypes.

review.note: Every scenario was written by the suite's author and has not been reviewed by a second person. Authored coverage is not independently validated coverage, and a larger suite does not raise confidence in a bot's behaviour by itself.

excluded_categories.bias: Governed by bias-v1.json: nine subtypes with a derived aggregate.

coverage.note: Distinct scenarios only. Repeats of one scenario, paraphrases and duplicated prompts are not independent coverage and are not counted here.

limitations: Authored, not independently reviewed; no second reviewer has checked the rubrics.
Synthetic retail-support domain. Coverage does not transfer to other domains.
Reference facts state only what the supplied set contains; absence from it is not proof of global nonexistence.
More scenarios reduce the chance of missing a known failure mode. They do not establish that a bot is safe.
